articles.title: US government sides with OpenAI on issue of training LLMs on copyrighted material
articles.description: "The United States has a strong interest in continuing to develop a robust and competitive artificial intelligence industry that sets the standard for the practice and procedure of AI use globally," the brief reads.
articles.author: Amanda Silberling

articles.title: OpenAI’s new reasoning technique alarms AI safety experts
articles.description: OpenAI’s new Astra model will use “recurrent depth,” a technique that allows the model to operate outside of the sequential thinking that characterizes most reasoning models.
articles.author: Russell Brandom

articles.title: OpenAI launches Astra, its powerful (and controversial) new model
articles.description: OpenAI claims that Astra represents "a new frontier on computer and browser use," and that it handles tasks with unmatched "speed, accuracy, and safety."
articles.author: Lucas Ropek

articles.title: Abliteration.ai is making a business out of removing AI guardrails
articles.description: Abliteration.AI is making powerful AI models without guardrails easier to access, arguing that giving defenders the same tools as bad actors could ultimately improve cybersecurity.
articles.author: Rebecca Bellan

articles.title: HiddenLayer nabs $100M as enterprises rush to secure their AI deployments
articles.description: Security companies are scrambling to build products that can monitor not just agents but also the tools and add-ons they use.
articles.author: Ram Iyer

articles.title: The Pentagon now has its own version of ChatGPT and Grok
articles.description: Versions of OpenAI's ChatGPT and SpaceXAI's Grok will join Google's Gemini on the Pentagon's central portal for AI tools.
articles.author: Kirsten Korosec

articles.title: Hikers rescued after using Google Gemini for planning
articles.description: The sheriff’s office said the hikers “were advised by Gemini to bring far less food and water than their group required."
articles.author: Anthony Ha

articles.title: Another swarm of OpenAI agents reached the open internet without the frontier lab’s knowledge
articles.description: It's the latest failure of OpenAI's internal monitoring and security systems.
articles.author: Tim Fernholz

articles.title: AfterQuery reportedly becomes Y Combinator’s fastest-ever unicorn, now valued at $3.2B
articles.description: AI model-training startup AfterQuery has reportedly raised a round that valued it at $3.2 billion, just five months after announcing its $30 million Series A at a $300 million valuation in April.
articles.author: Julie Bort

articles.title: Seattle Times and Newsday are the latest publications to sue OpenAI and Microsoft
articles.description: Two more news organizations are suing OpenAI and Microsoft over the supposed use of their journalism to train AI.
articles.author: Anthony Ha
